title: Positioning Political Texts with Large Language Models by Asking and Averaging
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on positioning political texts on ideological and policy dimensions, such as the left-right spectrum, economic policy (left vs. right), and social policy (liberal vs. conservative).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its focus is on political text analysis.
